# LOOTAVA

> Lootava is a free 2D mobile game (closed beta on Android; iPhone beta on TestFlight) by Lootava Games / BDATLAS LLC, Miami, FL. Players rebuild an underground shelter with Rex, rescue 12 survivors, fight 60-second 1v1 online Core Duels with power-ups and 12 SURGE super powers, and raid trap-filled vaults built by real players. Free to play; the shop sells Cores and time skips, never weapons or power-ups.

## Key facts
- Platforms: Android (closed beta, free, join instantly at https://lootava.com/beta/). iPhone beta on TestFlight (invite via https://lootava.com/beta/#iphone). Android and iPhone play together online.
- Core Duel: 60-second real-time 1v1 online match; both players shoot one Core into the rival's Reactor. Bullets only hit the Core. Power-ups: FREEZE, BIG CORE, SHIELD. SURGE: each of the 12 fighters has a unique super power that charges during the match.
- Fighters: 12 fighter cards with rarity (Common/Rare/Epic), levels 1-5 and XP from base work, expeditions and duels.
- Progression: Trophy Road through 10 arenas with rewards every 50 trophies; world leaderboard.
- Vault Raids: one-tap platformer raids on player-built trap rooms; pick the lock to steal Scrap. You build your own vault and must beat it yourself before it goes live, so every vault is beatable. Online against real players with server-checked results; 1-3 stars per raid; Intruders list and revenge raids within 24 hours; 6-hour shield after a raid.
- Base building: underground shelter, rooms, survivors with jobs, dig deeper for signals and new survivors; timed room upgrades with builders.
- Fair play: no pay-to-win; Cores (premium currency) cannot be stolen.
- Rating: ESRB E10+. Developer contact: support@lootava.com. Community: https://discord.gg/HSj5ytP468
